about: Crafted damage both suites apply: one edit (replace the first match, cut bytes off the end, or insert a byte) to one member (default sheet2.xml) of a base workbook (default snapshot), re-zipped. expect: ok, unreadable (WorkbookError, exit 2) or refused (LadderError, exit 1); message is in both readers' text. Review found the readers disagreeing on NaN, Infinity, 1e999, 2_500, 0x9C4, index -1 and the cut part.
